celestial_frame_audit.reference_model: Astropy WGS84 EarthLocation -> GCRS with IERS auto-download disabled

tests: own-footprint vs common-intersection strict-HQ source incidences

gaia_id_integrity.exact_integer_rule: never parse catalogue identifiers through float
gaia_id_integrity.source: retained v094i raw TAP VOTables vs frozen NPZ caches

decision_rules: Do not use v094n/v094o for parallax inference until this gate is interpreted.
If any cached Gaia value maps to more than one distinct exact raw Gaia ID, rebuild exact-ID caches before equality-based Gaia use.
If timing/frame diagnostics materially exceed 2 arcsec, replace fixed-time/GMST geometry before another matcher.
A future physical parallax search must use side-specific footprints, not common-intersection source pools.
A future null must be calibrated on no-signal catalogues conditioned on actual footprint/selection geometry.

known_at_freeze.footprint_issue: v094n/v094o clip both source pools to the common intersection; a displaced parallax pair only requires each endpoint to lie on its own selected solution footprint.
known_at_freeze.frame_issue: v094n eci() applies a GMST-only z rotation to WGS84 Earth-fixed positions while source coordinates are labelled ICRS.
known_at_freeze.gaia_integer_issue: v094i masked_val(kind=int) routes gaiaedr3_id through float before int64 storage; exact identity preservation is not established.
known_at_freeze.timing_issue: v094n/v094o use one effective baseline rather than search event time across the allowed overlap interval; multi-fragment geometry mixes a duration-averaged baseline with an absolute site origin from the first overlap midpoint.
known_at_freeze.v094o_interpretation: Rotated directions are not exchangeable against fixed footprints/source distributions. v094o is a directional diagnostic, not a calibrated significance test.

scientific_role: Validate identity, timing, celestial-frame, and footprint semantics before any further parallax inference or candidate unblinding. v094n/v094o remain preserved exploratory products.
stop_rule: STOP after aggregate measurement-integrity report. No candidate unblinding or new parallax search.
